body: The mop and rinse bucket share gray foam from the field-sprayer test. They were bundled before the radio warned everyone indoors.
title: Mop and rinse bucket, friday before dawn
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same gray foam while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body: A water bottle is tied to a pencil with string. The scratched tally on the bottle differs from the number copied onto the sheet beside it.
title: A corrected tally by the wall
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
